mainEntity.name: What is MCP Tool Search in Claude Code 2.1?

acceptedAnswer.text: A feature that defers loading full tool schemas until explicitly needed, preventing context exhaustion from multiple large MCP servers.

mainEntity.name: How much token usage does MCP Tool Search save?

acceptedAnswer.text: Benchmarked tests demonstrate an average 85 percent reduction in initial context consumption across complex multi-server setups.

mainEntity.name: Does tool search improve model accuracy?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes. Opus 4.5 accuracy increased from 79.5 percent to 88.1 percent due to reduced distraction in the active context window.

mainEntity.name: How does Claude Code integrate with external APIs?

acceptedAnswer.text: Through the open Model Context Protocol, enabling secure bi-directional communication between the LLM and external systems.
